verification_oracle: all mapped acceptance_ids pass on the exact target subject; UNKNOWN and NOT_RUN never count as PASS

results.name: 自动注册与同意
results.note: 「开始」 only creates a pending row and 「同意并开始」 is the single activation call site; every pre-active state declares modelCalls 0 and the suite proves a pre-consent model call throws.

results.name: 一次性设置链接
results.note: The setup token is 10 minutes (TTL not raisable), single-use under BEGIN IMMEDIATE, stored only as SHA-256, and travels in the URL fragment so it never enters a request line or log. Repeat, expired and purpose-mismatched consumption are all refused.

results.name: Web Session 安全
results.note: Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Strict cookie, exact HTTPS origin allowlist, Host allowlist, constant-time CSRF, frozen 9-action allowlist with no Owner capability, 16 KiB body cap checked before parsing, server-owned session user, and one-command global revocation.

results.name: 跨设备连续性
results.note: A returning WeChat principal resumes the same user with no new row; there is no email/password or second account system, and the same sender on a different bot account is a different principal.

results.name: 邀请制与暂停
results.note: Unknown senders reach only the minimal pending state. Invite codes are Owner-issued, HMAC-SHA256 keyed-hash stored, at least 12 characters, bounded and atomic in use, expirable and revocable; an invalid code creates no user. Only active users may reach a model, so pending and suspended users have 0.
